identity_boundary: Seven separately preserved DjVu scan carriers for Manmatha Nath Dutt's 1891-1894 English prose translation of Valmiki's Ramayana, covering Bala, Ayodhya, Aranya, Kishkindha, Sundara, Yuddha and Uttara Kanda. This is one historical English edition, not every recension, translation, commentary, Ramcharitmanas, or the complete Ramayana tradition.
